hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *lib/commands/*.dart|*lib/session/*.dart|*bin/claudart.dart) echo '📝 README may need updating — run /readme to sync glossary and architecture.' ;; esac # file_path arrives via stdin JSON (tool_input.file_path), not an env var — there is no CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH. Output is a static string only — never interpolate $file into the echo. File paths may contain sensitive identifiers.
